tagline: The tool-head board: an STM32F303 with 25 tool profiles over CAN, a bootloader that updates it over the same cable and an expansion slave.
description: URTC is the firmware of a tool-head controller board and its hardware files. The application reads a five-jumper identity, runs the profile of that tool (heaters with a thermal guard, motors, laser, welders, sensors), answers on CAN, shows what it does on an OLED and keeps its setpoints in an F-RAM. A bootloader with a backup slot lets the application be replaced over CAN after a first setup over SWD. An expansion slave chip serves add-on boards. No populated board exists yet; the logic is tested on a computer.
